Ancient Mega Pack: ULTRA

Champion! You have proven your strength in battle. Brand this whole run with ULTRA?

Every enemy grows tougher: more armour, sharper saving throws, more health, a wider stride and a heavier blow.
Every boss roars louder still.
Mirror Support: weaken a boss and lock it down, and a random Mirror mini-boss steps out of the Void to its side, carrying a signature threat of its own. Cut it down and the rare loot is yours.

ULTRA rides with you for the whole run: it holds through every fight and survives a save reload.
There is exactly one way out: the DISABLE ULTRA spell on your hotbar. Cast it, confirm, and the mode is off for good. Once off, it can never be turned back on.

Press Yes to take up the challenge.
Press No to leave everything as it is.
